notes: Tune the insert hole, tube fits (temple 4.05 glue / 4.35 run, visor 4.2 friction) and the magnet pocket, then rebuild.
Ream the temple knuckles to 4.35 and the visor knuckles to 4.2 (friction holds the visor up). Press the 6x3 magnet in.
Drill the knuckle to 4.05 and glue the tube. The cell drops into the earpiece bay from the head side.
Fit 4 M2 inserts in the back bosses. Visor knuckles: drill to 4.05 and glue the tubes.
The eyepiece sleeves hold the optics with crush ribs. Fits with 4 x M2x6.
Slide over the earpiece to close the battery bay. Feed TPU from the external spool.
